patches=clock,multiplier,nolazy,fastreject,zone,onepoint,pairs
  clock: util/ktx/Instant.kt: systemTimeNow() reads a settable `var systemClock: Clock` (default Clock.System)
  multiplier: data/elementfilter/filters/RelativeDate.kt: MULTIPLIER reads a thread-local override first (`multiplierOverride`)
  nolazy: data/elementfilter/filters/RelativeDate.kt: `date` is a getter again, not `by lazy`
  nolazy: data/elementfilter/filters/ElementFilter.kt: `dateTimestamp` is a getter again, not `by lazy` (two classes)
  fastreject: data/elementfilter/ElementFilterExpression.kt: works out the keys an expression needs (`keyReject`)
  fastreject: data/elementfilter/ElementFilterExpression.kt: matches() rejects an element without those keys at once
  zone: util/ktx/Instant.kt: systemTimeZone(), a thread-local override (`systemTimeZoneOverride`) before the JVM zone
  zone: util/ktx/LocalDate.kt: toInstant() in systemTimeZone()
  zone: util/ktx/LocalDateTime.kt: toInstant() in systemTimeZone()
  zone: util/ktx/LocalDateTime.kt: now() in systemTimeZone()
  zone: util/ktx/LocalDateTime.kt: minusInSystemTimeZone() and plusInSystemTimeZone() in systemTimeZone()
  onepoint: util/math/SphericalEarthMath.kt: intersectsWith() is false for a polyline of one point instead of failing
  pairs: util/ktx/Collections.kt: asSequenceOfPairs() is openquests.pairsOf, a plain iterator; SC's body stays as asSequenceOfPairsAsInStreetComplete()
